scope: Original-author or official-publisher X cases for actual Claude Code function-hook mods
verification_note: This review verifies attribution and mod source structure, not runtime behavior, security or claims of quality. Public X post text and media presence were observed; video behavior was not independently reproduced. Publication dates are the dates shown on original X pages. No engagement metrics are used. Author-authored does not claim the earliest historical announcement.

entries.name: Token Weather
entries.practical_value: A weather-style context gauge with a recent-turn sparkline makes context growth visible without opening a separate dashboard.
entries.practical_value_zh: 用天气状态与近期轮次的小图持续显示上下文增长，无需切换到单独的面板。
entries.caveat: The percentage uses the full model window, not the auto-compaction threshold. It updates after turns; it is a teaching sample, not a supported product.
entries.caveat_zh: 百分比以完整上下文窗口为基准，不等于自动压缩阈值；轮次结束后更新。这是教学示例，不是受支持的产品。
entries.upstream_version_evidence: Requires 2.1.287+; upstream reports live testing on 2.1.280 and validation on 2.1.285. Not retested here.

entries.name: Replay Theater
entries.practical_value: Step through the last editing turn one attempted Edit or Write at a time. Useful for learning how a change unfolded before checking the final Git diff.
entries.practical_value_zh: 按顺序回看上一轮的 Edit／Write 修改尝试，先理解修改过程，再核对最终 Git diff。
entries.caveat: It can record denied or failed attempts and truncates displayed diffs; it is not proof of final disk contents. Session-local teaching sample, not a supported product.
entries.caveat_zh: 可能包含被拒绝或失败的修改尝试，差异视图也会截断；不能据此证明文件最终状态。会话内教学示例，不是受支持的产品。

entries.name: Blast Radius
entries.practical_value: Hold selected risky Bash commands and inspect a side-pane impact preview before choosing whether to proceed. An instructive example of a human decision inside a tool-call hook.
entries.practical_value_zh: 暂停部分高风险 Bash 命令，在侧栏查看影响后决定是否执行，是把人工决策接入工具调用钩子的教学案例。
entries.caveat: Heuristic command matching is not a security boundary and misses wrappers or shell constructs. Migration previews may load project code. Test only in a disposable project; upstream notes some later fixes were not re-run live.
entries.caveat_zh: 启发式命令匹配不是安全边界，会漏掉包装脚本及部分 shell 语法；迁移预览可能加载项目代码。仅在可丢弃项目中评估，上游说明部分后续修复尚未重新实测。

entries.name: Mindful Claude
entries.practical_value: A breathing animation appears while Claude is working and disappears when the turn ends. A compact example of turn-aware UI that does not need model-generated content.
entries.practical_value_zh: Claude 工作时显示呼吸节奏动画，轮次结束后消失，是无需模型生成内容的轻量、轮次感知界面示例。
entries.caveat: Treat it as a UI/focus experiment; no medical benefit is claimed here. Its README retains early-access flag instructions, and current-runtime compatibility was not tested.
entries.caveat_zh: 仅作为界面和专注体验实验收录，不宣称医疗收益。README 仍保留早期访问开关说明，未在当前版本运行验证。
entries.upstream_version_evidence: Upstream requires 2.1.269+ with old flag instructions; current compatibility untested.

entries.name: terminal-browser
entries.practical_value: Open a real browser inside a Claude Code pane to preview a local website or HTML output beside the conversation. The plugin also exposes a browser API for other mods.
entries.practical_value_zh: 在 Claude Code 侧栏打开真实浏览器，并排预览本地网站或 HTML 产物；还可通过插件 API 供其他 Mod 使用。
entries.caveat: Requires the separate terminal-browser binary and kitty graphics protocol with Unicode placeholders. The author marks it experimental; tmux integration, mouse alignment and layout have documented limits. Installing or browsing may involve local-network permissions and normal website traffic.
entries.caveat_zh: 依赖单独的 terminal-browser 程序，以及支持 kitty 图形协议和 Unicode 占位符的终端。作者标为实验性，tmux 集成、鼠标位置和布局存在限制；安装与浏览可能涉及本地网络权限及正常网站流量。
entries.upstream_version_evidence: Author asks for latest Claude Code but gives no numeric minimum; README still includes early-access flag. Current runtime not tested.
